prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a single square photographic texture atlas for an art game: exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, sixteen equally sized square panels, with zero gutters, zero margins, zero frames, zero labels. The image must be square. Each cell is a completely independent believable photograph, never a continuous scene spanning cells.
Primary request: create sixteen extremely convincing ordinary amateur travel/nature/still-life photographs. They should be difficult to distinguish from photographs taken with consumer digital cameras around 2014. Natural slightly imperfect framing, varied exposure and white balance, fine sensor grain, unremarkable believable physical details. Mostly daylight, restrained muted natural colors, occasional brighter greens or blues. No illustration, no CGI sheen, no cinematic grading, no dramatic fantasy, no conspicuous errors.
Panels in strict row-major order:
row 1: (1) conifer treetops above a deep blue inlet with low mountains far away, seen from an overlook; (2) shallow winding stream through wet meadow with forest and low fog; (3) ordinary beach at low tide with dark foreground rocks and distant wooded island; (4) pebbly lakeshore, blue water, evergreen trees along the left shore.
row 2: (5) uneven coastal rocks beside flat gray sea under pale overcast sky; (6) small narrow waterfall dropping into rocky forest creek with scattered fallen logs; (7) bleached driftwood and rounded stones at blue lake edge; (8) straight pale gravel footpath between meadow grass and deciduous trees.
row 3: (9) close photograph of grass seed stems with out-of-focus green meadow and blue sky; (10) close upward view along a moss-covered tree trunk into leafy branches; (11) overhead casual desk with partial cream keyboard, closed muted-color books and open notebook, tiny markings illegible; (12) close shallow-focus open paperback on a dark wooden table, illegible tiny print, cream wall behind.
row 4: (13) dried branching flower stems backlit by pale pink evening sky; (14) amber sunset across low ocean surf viewed from sandstone shore; (15) rocky creek in lush deciduous woodland in early summer; (16) steep gray snowy mountain valley with low clouds and blue sky.
Constraints: every panel independently composed, no text overlays, no numbering, no watermark, no borders, exact regular 4 by 4 grid occupying entire square image. No people or animals. This is one texture atlas, not a screenshot of a CAPTCHA. Aim for plausible photographs rather than beautiful illustrations.
encoding: JPEG quality 82; original pixels retained before encoding; browser crops 2px from each tile edge and rasterizes all sources identically.
